{"parentUuid":"e93a7e63-d026-43b8-88cc-a540145681e5","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"skill_listing","content":"- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors (\"from now on when X\", \"each time X\", \"whenever X\", \"before/after X\") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions (\"allow X\", \"add permission\", \"move permission to\"), env vars (\"set X=Y\"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: \"allow npm commands\", \"add bq permission to global settings\", \"move permission to user settings\", \"set DEBUG=true\", \"when claude stops show X\". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.\n- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: \"rebind ctrl+s\", \"add a chord shortcut\", \"change the submit key\", \"customize keybindings\".\n- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.\n- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.\n- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. \"check the deploy every 5 minutes\", \"keep running /babysit-prs\"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.\n- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run (\"run this once at 3pm\", \"remind me to check X tomorrow\").\n- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).\nTRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.\nSKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.\n- ccs-delegation: Auto-activate CCS CLI delegation for deterministic tasks. Parses user input, auto-selects optimal profile (glm/kimi/custom) from ~/.ccs/config.json, enhances prompts with context, executes via `ccs {profile} -p \"task\"` or `ccs {profile}:continue`, and reports results. Triggers on \"use ccs [task]\" patterns, typo/test/refactor keywords. Excludes complex architecture, security-critical code, performance optimization, breaking changes.\n- attach: Port the Claude Code harness layer from this project to a new project directory. Use when bootstrapping a fresh Claude Code project on the same machine, when peers want to copy the harness, or when verifying layer separation via dry-run. Reads .claude/manifest.yaml; copies harness-tagged artifacts only; excludes stockforge biz + personal layers; generates skeleton CLAUDE.md + manifest at target.\n- crawler-reliability: Build reliable web crawlers for data gathering. Use when implementing scrapers for CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz, YouTube (yt-dlp), Facebook fanpages, or any external data source. Covers Python/Playwright patterns, retry/backoff, selector robustness, rate limiting, monitoring.\n- ddd-tactical-patterns: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n- decompose-work: Split a non-trivial task into deterministic-vs-LLM portions before execution. Use when planning multi-step work where some sub-tasks are mechanical (file ops, regex, count, schema validation) and others require judgment (synthesis, design, ambiguity resolution). Outputs structured plan that maps each portion to the cheapest competent tool. Pairs with capability-map.md (model × effort × task_class grounding) and try-n-approaches (S9 — Karpathy autoresearch loop).\n- evidence-extraction: Extract structured claims from unstructured sources with citation integrity. Use when building extraction pipelines, parsing news articles or KOL transcripts, or anywhere claims are created from raw data. Ensures every claim has source_url, extracted_at, confidence, and verified attribution. Enforces no-LLM-math invariant (I-S1).\n- fastapi-module: Implement FastAPI routers following StockForge conventions. Use when creating a new HTTP endpoint, adding routes, wiring dependency injection, configuring Pydantic DTOs. Covers router boundaries, provider patterns, testing setup. Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n- grill-maximization: Doctrine for bundling Q&A questions to the human at maximum density per turn (15-20 target, max 25), so each human-in-the-loop touchpoint is information-rich. Use when composing a Q&A bundle for human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, or when deciding whether to ask one question or wait and bundle. Built on the principle that human-in-the-loop time is the scarcest resource in autonomous coding.\n- obsidian-vault: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n- postgres-pgvector: Design Postgres schemas with pgvector and TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\n- promote-rule: Cluster agent-notes.md entries by lexical similarity, propose promotion of recurring rules to deterministic hook (priority 1), skill (priority 2), or charter (priority 3). Use when agent-notes has accumulated ≥10 new rules since last promotion run, or on-demand at phase boundary. Outputs proposal markdown to observations/. Pairs with capability-map.md (writes new task_class entries) and decompose-work (consumes promotion outcomes).\n- prompt-engineering: Design and optimize LLM prompts for StockForge pipeline stages. Use when writing or refining prompts for claim extraction, KOL recommendation extraction, sentiment analysis, thesis synthesis. Covers context assembly, prompt caching strategy, budget-aware prompts, structured output. Enforces no-LLM-math constraint.\n- qa-escalation: File-based Q&A protocol — composes bundle file in human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, tracks lifecycle (pending → answered → stale → processed), creates URGENT notification when needed. Use when intent classifier recommends OPEN_QA_BUNDLE / ESCALATE_HUMAN, or grill-maximization has a bundle ready to write. Pairs with grill-maximization (composes content) + Track 5 hooks (auto-move stale).\n- spec-dual-layer: Write specifications with dual-layer structure (business narrative + agent contract). Use when authoring new specs, refining existing specs, or understanding the spec template. Ensures both human stakeholder needs and agent execution needs are served.\n- spec-to-wiki: Convert raw specifications to Obsidian wiki format with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index updates. Use when adding a new spec to the knowledge base, or when regenerating wiki view after spec changes. Maintains raw as source of truth, wiki as navigable view.\n- test-pyramid-balance: Balance unit, integration, and E2E tests properly in Python/pytest. Use when deciding what test to write, reviewing test coverage, or rebalancing skewed test suite. Covers test pyramid shape, BDD vs unit tests, when to use what. Includes stock-domain-specific test categories.\n- try-n-approaches: Karpathy autoresearch outer-loop framing — given a task or signal, generate ≥3 distinct approaches (DEEPEN / BROADEN / ABANDON families), pick one per cheap-first ordering, attach a deterministic metric function (per L-S12-1), and write the experiment frame to learning-data/loop/. Use when an open question surfaces from drift / dogfood / sync-grilling and you need to commit a measurable next step. Pairs with decompose-work (deterministic-vs-LLM split per approach) + capability-map (model × effort grounding) + promote-rule (consumes outcomes).\n- ubiquitous-language: Extract a DDD-style ubiquitous language glossary from the current conversation or domain area. Use when starting work on a new bounded context, when new domain terms emerge, or when verifying consistency between business language and code. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed.\n- user-prompt-intake: Hybrid intent classifier — main session lite-detects trivial prompts, dispatches intent-classifier subagent for complex ones. Use whenever a new user prompt lands (chat or file in human-workspace/user_prompt/) and you need to route the work. Built for full-autonomous loop where every prompt must be classified before action.\n- write-a-skill: Create new Claude Code skills with proper structure, progressive disclosure, and discoverability. Use when extracting a pattern from multiple sessions into a reusable skill, or when user asks to formalize a technique. {"parentUuid":"0cd83b25-937a-4e3b-8725-c786c71fa3d0","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"578d4554-a69a-4980-8f89-2d9af4967ffa","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_018NEygoDz5mnhbzDcFdFA5P","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t# PROJECT CHARTER\n2\t## StockForge — Personal Investment Advisor for Vietnamese Stock Market\n3\t\n4\t> **Status**: Immutable v1.0 — changes require explicit charter revision.\n5\t> **Scope of immutability**: Vision, principles, success criteria.\n6\t> **Things that do evolve**: Agent configs, specs, implementation, signal weights, eval sets.\n7\t\n8\t---\n9\t\n10\t## Vision\n11\t\n12\tAn AI-first investment research and advisory system that combines **quant fund methodology** with **Vietnam-specific edge sources** (KOL networks, crowd sentiment, pump pattern detection) to surface high-conviction opportunities in an inefficient market where logic-based screening alone is insufficient.\n13\t\n14\tPrimary user: project owner (self) + 3-5 trusted peers in Vietnamese investing community.\n15\t\n16\tPrimary goal: build a system that compounds edge over time through proprietary data accumulation, not through any single clever algorithm. After 12-24 months of dogfood, the system should be a genuine advisor I would pay money for if someone else built it.\n17\t\n18\tNot a goal: high-frequency trading, replacing human judgment, becoming a SaaS in Year 1, beating frontier LLMs at general reasoning, providing licensed financial advice.\n19\t\n20\t---\n21\t\n22\t## The Core Insight (the why)\n23\t\n24\t**Quant funds (Renaissance, Two Sigma, DE Shaw) win in efficient markets through clean data + execution speed + diverse alpha factors.** They don't use sentiment from Facebook/YouTube because at their scale it's noise, not signal — and in efficient markets it gets arbitraged away anyway.\n25\t\n26\t**Vietnam stock market inverts this.** It is structurally inefficient:\n27\t- 85-90% retail investor share (vs 20-25% in US)\n28\t- Information asymmetry between sophisticated and retail crowd\n29\t- KOL/influencer recommendations measurably move prices\n30\t- \"Đội lái\" (pump operators) operate openly\n31\t- News and narrative cycles dominate over fundamentals for months at a time\n32\t- Foreign flow creates non-fundamental price pressure\n33\t\n34\tIn this market, **sentiment + influence + narrative tracking is signal, not noise**. And LLMs can process Vietnamese unstructured text at scale that was impossible before 2023.\n35\t\n36\tThis creates a **structural arbitrage**: apply quant methodology + LLM reasoning + sentiment/influence data layers that no commercial product offers for VN. Position not as \"decision maker\" but as **advisor + alert watcher + bias mirror**.\n37\t\n38\t---\n39\t\n40\t## The Craft Philosophy\n41\t\n42\tTake the craft seriously. Build for personal use first, commercial second.\n43\t\n44\t- Production-grade engineering standards from Day 1 (DDD + clean architecture + multi-loop discipline)\n45\t- Commercial extension kept as option, never as driver\n46\t- When self-use conflicts with hypothetical-future-SaaS, self-use wins\n47\t- Quality bar: I genuinely trust output enough to act on real money decisions\n48\t- Edge comes from compounding moats (proprietary data, calibration, personal bias log), not from any single feature\n49\t\n50\tReference models: Renaissance Technologies (data + iteration discipline), Bridgewater (principles-based decision making), personal Bloomberg Terminal (data density + analysis depth), Athletic.com (subscription-quality content for niche audience).\n51\t\n52\t---\n53\t\n54\t## Core Principles (non-negotiable)\n55\t\n56\t1. **Evidence grounding** — every claim, every number traceable to source + as-of date. Hallucination in finance = bug, not stylistic issue.\n57\t\n58\t2. **Structured output over narrative** — multi-criteria assessment, never single \"buy/sell\" score. Output is trade-off matrix.\n59\t\n60\t3. **Adversarial by design** — bear + bull + critic + quant + behavior + manager perspectives. Never consensus from single agent.\n61\t\n62\t4. **Proprietary data moat** — every news ingested, every KOL recommendation tracked, every thesis post-mortem'd compounds the edge. Raw data is sacred.\n63\t\n64\t5. **Pattern transfer + local adaptation** — global setups (cyclical bottom, dividend value, GARP) + Vietnam-specific overlays (policy timing, foreign flow, narrative phase).\n65\t\n66\t6. **Human-in-loop is the product** — augment thinking, never replace it. System should challenge user's gut instinct without overriding it.\n67\t\n68\t7. **Dogfood mandatory** — if I don't use it weekly for real decisions, the feature gets killed. Self-use is the only validation that matters in Year 1.\n69\t\n70\t8. **Calibration over confidence** — system tracks its own accuracy across signal types, never claims confidence it hasn't earned through hit rate.\n71\t\n72\t9. **No LLM math** — LLM never generates numbers. All calculations through deterministic code with verified data inputs. LLM only interprets.\n73\t\n74\t10. **Position sizing & risk management are deterministic** — code-enforced rules, LLM cannot override. Maximum position size, sector concentration, stop loss rules are immutable per session.\n75\t\n76\t---\n77\t\n78\t## The Four-Tier Signal Architecture\n79\t\n80\tSystem operates on four distinct signal tiers, each with different lead time, reliability, and processing approach:\n81\t\n82\t**Tier 1 — Hard Data (deterministic):** prices, volumes, fundamentals, foreign flow, macro indicators. Zero LLM, pure code. Lead time: hours-days.\n83\t\n84\t**Tier 2 — Official Narrative (semi-structured):** mainstream financial news, broker reports, official company disclosures, government announcements. LLM extracts claims + classifies sentiment + detects contradictions. Lead time: real-time.\n85\t\n86\t**Tier 3 — Influence Network (semi-structured):** YouTube channels, Facebook KOL pages, Telegram channels, podcasts. LLM transcribes + extracts recommendations + tags entities. Calibration database tracks each KOL's accuracy over time. Lead time: can lead by days.\n87\t\n88\t**Tier 4 — Crowd Sentiment & Pump Detection (unstructured):** community forums, public chat groups, comments. LLM classifies sentiment + detects coordinated posting + identifies pump narratives + tracks narrative lifecycle phase. Lead time: typically lags price (signals exhaustion).\n89\t\n90\tThe combination — when Tier 1+2+3 agree before Tier 4 heats up = early opportunity; when Tier 4 hot but Tier 1+2 don't support = likely top — is the core analytical edge.\n91\t\n92\tSee `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md` for detailed tier specs.\n93\t\n94\t---\n95\t\n96\t## First Sub-Scope (locked 6 months)\n97\t\n98\t**Vietnam stocks listed on HOSE/HNX/UPCoM**, specifically:\n99\t- VN30 + mid-cap (vốn hóa 2,000-50,000 tỷ VND) for primary coverage\n100\t- Long-only equity strategies (no derivatives, no shorting)\n101\t- Holding periods: 1-month minimum, 6-24 month preferred\n102\t- Position sizing per stock: 5-15% of portfolio\n103\t\n104\tOut of scope (Year 1): derivatives, warrants (CW), short selling, cryptocurrency, fund products, foreign markets, day trading, automated execution.\n105\t\n106\t---\n107\t\n108\t## Honest Boundaries (what system does NOT do)\n109\t\n110\t- **Predict price** — system predicts narrative phase, money flow direction, mispricing level. Never a price target with false precision.\n111\t- **Replace fundamental research** — surfaces opportunities, user must verify thesis before acting.\n112\t- **Execute trades** — pure research/alert tool. Execution stays manual.\n113\t- **Provide licensed financial advice** — personal research aid only. Output explicitly framed as \"thesis exploration\", not \"buy/sell recommendation\".\n114\t- **Time the market precisely** — works on phase identification (early/mid/late), not on tick-level timing.\n115\t- **Insider information** — uses only public sources. No paid leaks, no insider channels, no anything that crosses legal/ethical lines.\n116\t\n117\t---\n118\t\n119\t## Success Criteria\n120\t\n121\t**Month 3 (end of Phase 1 — Foundation):**\n122\t- Tier 1 + 2 data pipeline operational for VN30\n123\t- 50 companies have basic dossier in wiki\n124\t- First 5 thesis recorded with formal structure\n125\t- Can run /thesis-validate on a stock end-to-end in <5 minutes\n126\t\n127\t**Month 6 (end of Phase 2 — Edge Sources):**\n128\t- 30+ KOL channels tracked, calibration database has >100 recommendations with outcomes pending\n129\t- Tier 3 + 4 ingestion operational for top 100 stocks\n130\t- First detectable pump pattern caught (warning issued before public dump)\n131\t- 20+ thesis logged, first 5 hit 3-month review\n132\t\n133\t**Month 9 (end of Phase 3 — Multi-perspective):**\n134\t- Bear/bull/critic/quant/macro/behavior agents operational\n135\t- Pattern library has 15+ Vietnam-specific patterns with outcome data\n136\t- Personal bias log shows 3+ identified biases\n137\t- Thesis hit rate measurable (statistically meaningful sample)\n138\t\n139\t**Month 12 (end of Phase 4 — Compounding):**\n140\t- Karpathy outer loop optimizing signal weights weekly\n141\t- Cross-validation: system suggestions vs my manual analysis = where do they diverge?\n142\t- 3-5 trusted peers using it, providing feedback\n143\t- Demonstrable alpha vs VN-Index on dogfood portfolio (or honest accounting of why not)\n144\t\n145\t**Ultimate signal of success**: When my gut says \"buy XYZ\", I check what StockForge says first — and seriously consider it when it disagrees.\n146\t\n147\t---\n148\t\n149\t## Technical Foundation (locked Phase 1-3)\n150\t\n151\t**Stack:**\n152\t- **Python primary** — for data science, LLM workflows, time-series, backtesting (heavier than IdeaForge which was TS-primary)\n153\t- **Postgres 16 + TimescaleDB + pgvector + pg_trgm** — single DB for time-series + relational + vector\n154\t- **Redis** — cache + pub/sub + queue broker\n155\t- **Cloudflare R2** — raw content storage (PDFs, transcripts, scraped pages)\n156\t- **Claude API primary** — Sonnet for most tasks, Opus for thesis synthesis\n157\t- **OpenAI embeddings** — text-embedding-3-small (Vietnamese acceptable)\n158\t- **NestJS** — only if/when we need a public-facing API (Phase 4+)\n159\t- **Streamlit/Next.js** — Streamlit for personal dashboard (Phase 1-2), Next.js if SaaS path\n160\t- **Apache Airflow / Prefect** — data pipeline orchestration\n161\t\n162\t**Architecture:**\n163\t- Clean Architecture with DDD tactical patterns (same as IdeaForge)\n164\t- 9 bounded contexts (see `agent-workspace/constitution/architecture.md`)\n165\t- Event-driven for cross-context communication\n166\t- Multi-loop execution (Karpathy outer + Continuous middle + Per-stock inner)\n167\t\n168\t**Development approach:**\n169\t- AI-first: Claude Code as primary builder, human as spec author + reviewer + bias-checker\n170\t- Spec-Driven (SDD) + Domain-Driven (DDD) + selective BDD\n171\t- Sandwich pattern (Architect → Dev → Verifier) from Day 1\n172\t- Verify-Before-Write (VBW) protocol mandatory\n173\t- Three-tier quality gates (deterministic / probabilistic / human)\n174\t\n175\t---\n176\t\n177\t## Data Sources (Tier 1 budget)\n178\t\n179\t**Free/cheap (Phase 1):**\n180\t- vnstock (open source) — historical EOD, fundamentals\n181\t- Vietstock public — financial reports\n182\t- TCBS API — semi-public market data\n183\t- CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz — news scraping\n184\t- Public YouTube channels — transcript via yt-dlp + Whisper\n185\t- Public Facebook fanpages — selective scraping (legal grey, careful scope)\n186\t\n187\t**Paid (Phase 2-3 if budget allows):**\n188\t- FiinPro Platform — comprehensive fundamental data (~30-100M VND/year)\n189\t- Wichart — pre-cleaned data\n190\t- SSI FastConnect — realtime quotes if needed\n191\t\n192\t**Budget cap Year 1**: 50M VND for data + LLM combined.\n193\t\n194\t---\n195\t\n196\t## Meta-Discipline\n197\t\n198\tThese charter principles override daily decisions:\n199\t\n200\t- **When in doubt, simplify** — minimum code that solves the problem, nothing speculative\n201\t- **Ship thin slices, not perfect systems** — each phase ends with something I actually use\n202\t- **Document what you learn, not what you plan** — post-mortem > prospective docs\n203\t- **Dogfood or delete** — features I don't use weekly get removed\n204\t- **Calibrate, don't guess** — every confidence claim must have outcome tracking\n205\t- **Stay agnostic about commercial outcome** — build for the craft, not for the exit\n206\t\n207\t---\n208\t\n209\t## Revision Protocol\n210\t\n211\tThis charter changes only when:\n212\t- A core principle proves materially wrong through 30+ hours of real use\n213\t- Scope demonstrably needs revision based on accumulated dogfood data\n214\t- Technical foundation invalidated by external event (tool deprecation, regulatory change, etc.)\n215\t\n216\tCharter revisions require:\n217\t- Written rationale with evidence (linked to specific sessions/post-mortems)\n218\t- 48-hour cool-down before committing change\n219\t- Explicit version bump (v1.0 → v2.0)\n220\t\n221\tMinor clarifications go in `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md`. This charter stays stable.\n222\t\n223\t---\n224\t\n225\t## Document Index\n226\t\n227\t| Document | Purpose | Stability |\n228\t|---|---|---|\n229\t| `PROJECT_CHARTER.md` (this) | Vision + principles | Immutable for ~3 months |\n230\t| `AGENT_OPERATING_MANUAL.md` | Agent configs, skills, workflows | Living, frequent updates |\n231\t| `SPEC_TEMPLATE.md` | How to write specs | Stable |\n232\t| `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md` | Strategic: signal architecture | Stable |\n233\t| `specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md` | First implementation spec | Stable |\n234\t| `specs/tier2-feature/002-influence-network-tracking.md` | KOL tracking system spec | Stable |\n235\t| `specs/tier2-feature/003-crowd-sentiment-pump-detection.md` | Pump detection spec | Stable |\n236\t| `specs/tier2-feature/004-multi-perspective-adversarial-agents.md` | Adversarial analysis spec | Stable |\n237\t| `specs/tier2-feature/005-karpathy-outer-loop.md` | Pipeline self-optimization spec | Stable |\n238\t| `agent-workspace/memory/project.md` | Current state | Continuously updated |\n239\t| `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md` | Learned rules | Append-mostly |\n240\t| `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/` | All thesis ever recorded | Append-only |\n241\t| `agent-workspace/memory/post-mortems/` | Thesis outcome reviews | Append-only |\n242\t| `agent-workspace/calibration/` | KOL accuracy, signal calibration data | Continuously updated |\n243\t\n244\t---\n245\t\n246\t## Anti-Charter (what we explicitly reject)\n247\t\n248\tTo stay focused, we reject these tempting paths:\n249\t\n250\t- **Predict prices with ML models** — models trained on VN price data overfit; no edge there.\n251\t- **Compete with broker research** — we have less data, less staff. We win on integration + edge sources, not on raw analysis depth.\n252\t- **Build for general retail public** — we build for ourselves and 3-5 peers. Mass market needs hand-holding we won't provide.\n253\t- **Trust LLM for numbers** — every numerical output must come from code with traceable inputs.\n254\t- **Build features without dogfooding** — speculative features die fast in this project.\n255\t- **Optimize for backtest performance** — Goodhart's Law is real. We optimize for forward decision quality.\n256\t- **Make money fast** — this is a 24-month project minimum to reach edge. Maximum position size, sector concentration, stop loss rules are immutable per session.\n\n---\n\n## The Four-Tier Signal Architecture\n\nSystem operates on four distinct signal tiers, each with different lead time, reliability, and processing approach:\n\n**Tier 1 — Hard Data (deterministic):** prices, volumes, fundamentals, foreign flow, macro indicators. Zero LLM, pure code. Lead time: hours-days.\n\n**Tier 2 — Official Narrative (semi-structured):** mainstream financial news, broker reports, official company disclosures, government announcements. LLM extracts claims + classifies sentiment + detects contradictions. Lead time: real-time.\n\n**Tier 3 — Influence Network (semi-structured):** YouTube channels, Facebook KOL pages, Telegram channels, podcasts. LLM transcribes + extracts recommendations + tags entities. Calibration database tracks each KOL's accuracy over time. Lead time: can lead by days.\n\n**Tier 4 — Crowd Sentiment & Pump Detection (unstructured):** community forums, public chat groups, comments. LLM classifies sentiment + detects coordinated posting + identifies pump narratives + tracks narrative lifecycle phase. Lead time: typically lags price (signals exhaustion).\n\nThe combination — when Tier 1+2+3 agree before Tier 4 heats up = early opportunity; when Tier 4 hot but Tier 1+2 don't support = likely top — is the core analytical edge.\n\nSee `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md` for detailed tier specs.\n\n---\n\n## First Sub-Scope (locked 6 months)\n\n**Vietnam stocks listed on HOSE/HNX/UPCoM**, specifically:\n- VN30 + mid-cap (vốn hóa 2,000-50,000 tỷ VND) for primary coverage\n- Long-only equity strategies (no derivatives, no shorting)\n- Holding periods: 1-month minimum, 6-24 month preferred\n- Position sizing per stock: 5-15% of portfolio\n\nOut of scope (Year 1): derivatives, warrants (CW), short selling, cryptocurrency, fund products, foreign markets, day trading, automated execution.\n\n---\n\n## Honest Boundaries (what system does NOT do)\n\n- **Predict price** — system predicts narrative phase, money flow direction, mispricing level. Never a price target with false precision.\n- **Replace fundamental research** — surfaces opportunities, user must verify thesis before acting.\n- **Execute trades** — pure research/alert tool. Execution stays manual.\n- **Provide licensed financial advice** — personal research aid only. Output explicitly framed as \"thesis exploration\", not \"buy/sell recommendation\".\n- **Time the market precisely** — works on phase identification (early/mid/late), not on tick-level timing.\n- **Insider information** — uses only public sources. No paid leaks, no insider channels, no anything that crosses legal/ethical lines.\n\n---\n\n## Success Criteria\n\n**Month 3 (end of Phase 1 — Foundation):**\n- Tier 1 + 2 data pipeline operational for VN30\n- 50 companies have basic dossier in wiki\n- First 5 thesis recorded with formal structure\n- Can run /thesis-validate on a stock end-to-end in <5 minutes\n\n**Month 6 (end of Phase 2 — Edge Sources):**\n- 30+ KOL channels tracked, calibration database has >100 recommendations with outcomes pending\n- Tier 3 + 4 ingestion operational for top 100 stocks\n- First detectable pump pattern caught (warning issued before public dump)\n- 20+ thesis logged, first 5 hit 3-month review\n\n**Month 9 (end of Phase 3 — Multi-perspective):**\n- Bear/bull/critic/quant/macro/behavior agents operational\n- Pattern library has 15+ Vietnam-specific patterns with outcome data\n- Personal bias log shows 3+ identified biases\n- Thesis hit rate measurable (statistically meaningful sample)\n\n**Month 12 (end of Phase 4 — Compounding):**\n- Karpathy outer loop optimizing signal weights weekly\n- Cross-validation: system suggestions vs my manual analysis = where do they diverge?\n- 3-5 trusted peers using it, providing feedback\n- Demonstrable alpha vs VN-Index on dogfood portfolio (or honest accounting of why not)\n\n**Ultimate signal of success**: When my gut says \"buy XYZ\", I check what StockForge says first — and seriously consider it when it disagrees.\n\n---\n\n## Technical Foundation (locked Phase 1-3)\n\n**Stack:**\n- **Python primary** — for data science, LLM workflows, time-series, backtesting (heavier than IdeaForge which was TS-primary)\n- **Postgres 16 + TimescaleDB + pgvector + pg_trgm** — single DB for time-series + relational + vector\n- **Redis** — cache + pub/sub + queue broker\n- **Cloudflare R2** — raw content storage (PDFs, transcripts, scraped pages)\n- **Claude API primary** — Sonnet for most tasks, Opus for thesis synthesis\n- **OpenAI embeddings** — text-embedding-3-small (Vietnamese acceptable)\n- **NestJS** — only if/when we need a public-facing API (Phase 4+)\n- **Streamlit/Next.js** — Streamlit for personal dashboard (Phase 1-2), Next.js if SaaS path\n- **Apache Airflow / Prefect** — data pipeline orchestration\n\n**Architecture:**\n- Clean Architecture with DDD tactical patterns (same as IdeaForge)\n- 9 bounded contexts (see `agent-workspace/constitution/architecture.md`)\n- Event-driven for cross-context communication\n- Multi-loop execution (Karpathy outer + Continuous middle + Per-stock inner)\n\n**Development approach:**\n- AI-first: Claude Code as primary builder, human as spec author + reviewer + bias-checker\n- Spec-Driven (SDD) + Domain-Driven (DDD) + selective BDD\n- Sandwich pattern (Architect → Dev → Verifier) from Day 1\n- Verify-Before-Write (VBW) protocol mandatory\n- Three-tier quality gates (deterministic / probabilistic / human)\n\n---\n\n## Data Sources (Tier 1 budget)\n\n**Free/cheap (Phase 1):**\n- vnstock (open source) — historical EOD, fundamentals\n- Vietstock public — financial reports\n- TCBS API — semi-public market data\n- CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz — news scraping\n- Public YouTube channels — transcript via yt-dlp + Whisper\n- Public Facebook fanpages — selective scraping (legal grey, careful scope)\n\n**Paid (Phase 2-3 if budget allows):**\n- FiinPro Platform — comprehensive fundamental data (~30-100M VND/year)\n- Wichart — pre-cleaned data\n- SSI FastConnect — realtime quotes if needed\n\n**Budget cap Year 1**: 50M VND for data + LLM combined.\n\n---\n\n## Meta-Discipline\n\nThese charter principles override daily decisions:\n\n- **When in doubt, simplify** — minimum code that solves the problem, nothing speculative\n- **Ship thin slices, not perfect systems** — each phase ends with something I actually use\n- **Document what you learn, not what you plan** — post-mortem > prospective docs\n- **Dogfood or delete** — features I don't use weekly get removed\n- **Calibrate, don't guess** — every confidence claim must have outcome tracking\n- **Stay agnostic about commercial outcome** — build for the craft, not for the exit\n\n---\n\n## Revision Protocol\n\nThis charter changes only when:\n- A core principle proves materially wrong through 30+ hours of real use\n- Scope demonstrably needs revision based on accumulated dogfood data\n- Technical foundation invalidated by external event (tool deprecation, regulatory change, etc.)\n\nCharter revisions require:\n- Written rationale with evidence (linked to specific sessions/post-mortems)\n- 48-hour cool-down before committing change\n- Explicit version bump (v1.0 → v2.0)\n\nMinor clarifications go in `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md`. This charter stays stable.\n\n---\n\n## Document Index\n\n| Document | Purpose | Stability |\n|---|---|---|\n| `PROJECT_CHARTER.md` (this) | Vision + principles | Immutable for ~3 months |\n| `AGENT_OPERATING_MANUAL.md` | Agent configs, skills, workflows | Living, frequent updates |\n| `SPEC_TEMPLATE.md` | How to write specs | Stable |\n| `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md` | Strategic: signal architecture | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md` | First implementation spec | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/002-influence-network-tracking.md` | KOL tracking system spec | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/003-crowd-sentiment-pump-detection.md` | Pump detection spec | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/004-multi-perspective-adversarial-agents.md` | Adversarial analysis spec | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/005-karpathy-outer-loop.md` | Pipeline self-optimization spec | Stable |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/project.md` | Current state | Continuously updated |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md` | Learned rules | Append-mostly |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/` | All thesis ever recorded | Append-only |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/post-mortems/` | Thesis outcome reviews | Append-only |\n| `agent-workspace/calibration/` | KOL accuracy, signal calibration data | Continuously updated |\n\n---\n\n## Anti-Charter (what we explicitly reject)\n\nTo stay focused, we reject these tempting paths:\n\n- **Predict prices with ML models** — models trained on VN price data overfit; no edge there.\n- **Compete with broker research** — we have less data, less staff. We win on integration + edge sources, not on raw analysis depth.\n- **Build for general retail public** — we build for ourselves and 3-5 peers. Mass market needs hand-holding we won't provide.\n- **Trust LLM for numbers** — every numerical output must come from code with traceable inputs.\n- **Build features without dogfooding** — speculative features die fast in this project.\n- **Optimize for backtest performance** — Goodhart's Law is real. We optimize for forward decision quality.\n- **Make money fast** — this is a 24-month project minimum to reach edge. Quick wins are anti-pattern.\n","numLines":257,"startLine":1,"totalLines":257}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"0cd83b25-937a-4e3b-8725-c786c71fa3d0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"19d00132-2b36-43ad-a05d-5086b0b9d16c","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

Everything here represents **agent state, decisions, plans, observations, learning**. Agents WRITE here freely (within constitution rules); humans READ here but normally do not edit.\n\nThis separation exists to prevent two failure modes from orch:\n1. **Charter drift via shared-workspace mutation** (orch CF-DOGFOOD-2)\n2. **Human cognitive overload from dense session logs** (UP02 §1.3 — \"human đối mặt hàng chục spec/document quá tải nếu không sắp xếp khoa học\")\n\nThe agent owns this directory but must keep it AUDITABLE — every artifact provenance-linked, every decision sourced.\n\n---\n\n## Subdirectories\n\n| Path | Purpose | Lifecycle |\n|---|---|---|\n| `constitution/` | **IMMUTABLE without explicit user approval**. Charter-tier rules (autonomous-protocol, model-routing, identity-scope, etc.). Track 7 produces drafts in `proposals/`; user explicit approve to move here. | Edit denied by .claude/settings.json; Write only via human approval gate |\n| `memory/project.md` | High-level project state; phase tracker; ADRs (last 5). Update on phase boundaries + architectural decisions. | Long-lived; trim to most recent decisions |\n| `memory/current-execution.md` | **THE single routing source of truth**. Active phase + active session + autonomous_mode flag + routing table. Read FIRST every session. | Long-lived; updated each session boundary |\n| `memory/agent-notes.md` | Learned rules from real experience (post-mortem / drift / user correction). {"parentUuid":"f90dbc63-f113-4fd4-a0c0-84deaf7221ae","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"578d4554-a69a-4980-8f89-2d9af4967ffa","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01NWZqoHkYpFVsgaS89Uq9dY","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t# Provenance Protocol — DRAFT\n2\t\n3\t> **Status**: PROPOSAL — pending user approval in Track 7.\n4\t> **Move-to-constitution**: When user approves, this file moves to `agent-workspace/constitution/provenance-protocol.md` and becomes binding. Until then, agents SHOULD follow it but it is not enforced by deny-list.\n5\t> **Source decisions**: D-002 § Track 2 (REV-2) + Q&A clusters B/C/E (provenance + decision-id format + notification channels).\n6\t> **Author**: Claude Opus 4.7, S2 (2026-04-29).\n7\t\n8\t## Purpose\n9\t\n10\tDefine **WHEN** and **HOW** decisions, theses, and confidence claims are recorded so that any artifact in this repo can be traced backward to:\n11\t1. The human input(s) that motivated it.\n12\t2. The agent reasoning that produced it.\n13\t3. The verification step(s) that confirmed it.\n14\t4. Any downstream artifacts that depend on it.\n15\t\n16\tWithout this discipline, autonomous coding accumulates **silent drift** — the failure mode observed in orch (CF-DOGFOOD-2) where agent-decisions overrode human-CRITICAL items because there was no traceability protocol.\n17\t\n18\t---\n19\t\n20\t## Scope\n21\t\n22\tThis protocol applies to:\n23\t\n24\t| Artifact type | Storage | Provenance owner |\n25\t|---|---|---|\n26\t| Architectural decision | `agent-workspace/memory/decisions/D-NNN-*.md` | Agent (must cite) |\n27\t| Stock thesis | `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/<ticker>-<date>.md` | Agent (must cite source + as-of-date per I-S2) |\n28\t| Confidence claim | `agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker/sync-tracker.db` + auto-rendered `_index.md` | Agent (must trace to historical hit rate) |\n29\t| Charter exception / amendment | `human-workspace/decisions/D-H-NNN-*.md` | Human |\n30\t| Spec | `specs/**/*.md` | Mixed; agent may author, human approves |\n31\t| Pattern claim | `agent-workspace/memory/patterns-discovered/*.md` | Agent (must cite source artifact + path:line) |\n32\t| Drift signal | `agent-workspace/memory/drift-logs/<TS>-<signal>.md` | Hook script + agent commentary |\n33\t| Post-mortem | `agent-workspace/memory/post-mortems/<incident>.md` | Agent + human review |\n34\t\n35\t---\n36\t\n37\t## When to log a decision\n38\t\n39\tA new entry in `decisions/` is REQUIRED when one of:\n40\t\n41\t1. **CHARTER-touching**: any change that could affect mission, identity NOT-list, autonomous mode rules, or invariants I-S1..I-S35. → Q&A bundle FIRST; decision is the audit of the answered Q&A.\n42\t2. **SCOPE-touching**: phase boundary, multi-track plan, BC count change, port-list scope, dependency-direction reversal.\n43\t3. **ARCH-touching**: library substitution, schema migration, hook architecture, model-routing change.\n44\t4. **IMPL-touching with cross-cutting effect**: decision that affects ≥3 files in different bounded contexts. (Single-file refactors don't need decisions; commit message suffices.)\n45\t5. **Reversal**: any time an earlier decision is paused, revoked, or amended (REV-N or supersedes).\n46\t6. **User-prompt drop**: every `human-workspace/user_prompt/<file>.txt` triggers either a single decision or a Q&A bundle that resolves to one. NEVER silently absorbed.\n47\t\n48\tIf none of the above triggers apply, the action is a **routine implementation choice** — log in session journal, not in decisions/.\n49\t\n50\t---\n51\t\n52\t## How to log a decision\n53\t\n54\t### Step 1 — Author the file\n55\t\n56\tCreate `agent-workspace/memory/decisions/D-NNN-<slug>.md` using the canonical template:\n57\t- `agent-workspace/memory/decisions/_template.md`\n58\t\n59\tFrontmatter is BINDING (12+ fields). Empty arrays trigger drift detection (`DR-PROV` — unanchored claim).\n60\t\n61\t### Step 2 — Cite source_evidence\n62\t\n63\tEvery decision MUST cite at least one upstream source. Acceptable types (in priority order):\n64\t\n65\t1. `human-workspace/user_prompt/<file>.txt` (highest authority)\n66\t2. `human-workspace/decisions/D-H-NNN-*.md` (strategic human decision)\n67\t3. `human-workspace/q-and-a/answered/<file>.md` (resolved Q&A)\n68\t4. `agent-workspace/memory/patterns-discovered/*.md` (mining evidence)\n69\t5. `agent-workspace/memory/post-mortems/*.md` (failure-driven learning)\n70\t6. `agent-workspace/memory/drift-logs/*.md` (drift signal evidence)\n71\t7. `specs/**/*.md` (formal spec clause)\n72\t8. `PROJECT_CHARTER.md § X.Y` (charter section)\n73\t\n74\tA decision with `source_evidence: []` is **invalid** and will be flagged by the drift-detector hook (Track 5).\n75\t\n76\t### Step 3 — Determine level\n77\t\n78\t| Level | Self-decide threshold | Q&A required? |\n79\t|---|---|---|\n80\t| CHARTER | confidence ≥ 0.99 | Almost always YES; charter changes are rare |\n81\t| SCOPE | ≥ 0.90 | Often YES if affects phase or BC structure |\n82\t| ARCH | ≥ 0.80 | Optional; case-by-case |\n83\t| IMPL | ≥ 0.50 | Rarely needed |\n84\t\n85\tConfidence comes from the Confidence Score System (Track 8a) — per-category running estimate. If `sync-tracker.db` does not yet exist (pre-Track 8a), default to \"ask if uncertain.\"\n86\t\n87\t### Step 4 — Approval chain\n88\t\n89\tAppend entries to `approval_chain` as the decision moves PROPOSED → ACCEPTED → AMENDED → SUPERSEDED/REVOKED. Never delete prior entries.\n90\t\n91\t### Step 5 — Cross-link\n92\t\n93\t- Update `agent-workspace/memory/decisions/README.md` index table.\n94\t- If decision affects existing decisions: update their `superseded_by` or `verified_by` arrays.\n95\t- If decision affects code: list paths in `affects.code_paths`.\n96\t\n97\t### Step 6 — Verifier (Tier-2 gate)\n98\t\n99\tFor SCOPE+ decisions, dispatch `sandwich-verifier` subagent for adversarial review BEFORE marking ACCEPTED. The verifier checks:\n100\t- Does `source_evidence` actually contain what was cited?\n101\t- Are `options_considered` exhaustive (or is there a missing option)?\n102\t- Does `chosen_rationale` follow from evidence, or is it inference-only?\n103\t- Are `affects` lists complete (or are there hidden blast-radius surprises)?\n104\t\n105\tVerifier output is appended to `verified_by` field with mechanism `sandwich-verifier`.\n106\t\n107\t---\n108\t\n109\t## When to log a thesis\n110\t\n111\tPer I-S2 + I-S20, every thesis MUST include:\n112\t\n113\t- `source_url` (or local file path) for every fact cited\n114\t- `as_of_date` for every number\n115\t- `confidence` traced to historical hit rate, not LLM \"feeling certain\"\n116\t- `bear_case` section explicit (I-S10)\n117\t\n118\tThesis files live in `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/<ticker>-YYYY-MM-DD.md`. Schema details in `specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md`.\n119\t\n120\t---\n121\t\n122\t## When to log a confidence claim\n123\t\n124\tPer Track 8a (Confidence Score System):\n125\t\n126\t- Every Q&A answered triggers a category update (LANGUAGE, DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS, DESIGN_THINKING, SCOPE, DECISION_ROUTING).\n127\t- Every decision-correction or revocation drops the relevant category by `-2` or `-3` (asymmetric weights, Q&A A5).\n128\t- Hooks (Track 5) auto-update `sync-tracker.db`; agent does NOT manually edit it.\n129\t\n130\tA confidence claim made in narrative (\"I am 80% sure that…\") is INVALID unless it traces to a `sync-tracker.db` entry or `agent-workspace/calibration/<signal>.md` historical data.\n131\t\n132\t---\n133\t\n134\t## R7 Mitigation: Defer-Cycle Tracking\n135\t\n136\tPer Decision 002 REV-2 § C R7 (msmdp Decision Provenance Chain pattern):\n137\t\n138\t- Each defer of a decision increments `defer_cycles` by 1.\n139\t- `defer_cycles > 3` triggers drift-detector alert; mandatory Q&A bundle to either commit or revoke.\n140\t- `re_attempt_prereq` field documents what must change for resumption.\n141\t\n142\tThis is the deterministic backstop against can-kicking. Until then, agents SHOULD follow it but it is not enforced by deny-list.\n> **Source decisions**: D-002 § Track 2 (REV-2) + Q&A clusters B/C/E (provenance + decision-id format + notification channels).\n> **Author**: Claude Opus 4.7, S2 (2026-04-29).\n\n## Purpose\n\nDefine **WHEN** and **HOW** decisions, theses, and confidence claims are recorded so that any artifact in this repo can be traced backward to:\n1. The human input(s) that motivated it.\n2. The agent reasoning that produced it.\n3. The verification step(s) that confirmed it.\n4. Any downstream artifacts that depend on it.\n\nWithout this discipline, autonomous coding accumulates **silent drift** — the failure mode observed in orch (CF-DOGFOOD-2) where agent-decisions overrode human-CRITICAL items because there was no traceability protocol.\n\n---\n\n## Scope\n\nThis protocol applies to:\n\n| Artifact type | Storage | Provenance owner |\n|---|---|---|\n| Architectural decision | `agent-workspace/memory/decisions/D-NNN-*.md` | Agent (must cite) |\n| Stock thesis | `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/<ticker>-<date>.md` | Agent (must cite source + as-of-date per I-S2) |\n| Confidence claim | `agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker/sync-tracker.db` + auto-rendered `_index.md` | Agent (must trace to historical hit rate) |\n| Charter exception / amendment | `human-workspace/decisions/D-H-NNN-*.md` | Human |\n| Spec | `specs/**/*.md` | Mixed; agent may author, human approves |\n| Pattern claim | `agent-workspace/memory/patterns-discovered/*.md` | Agent (must cite source artifact + path:line) |\n| Drift signal | `agent-workspace/memory/drift-logs/<TS>-<signal>.md` | Hook script + agent commentary |\n| Post-mortem | `agent-workspace/memory/post-mortems/<incident>.md` | Agent + human review |\n\n---\n\n## When to log a decision\n\nA new entry in `decisions/` is REQUIRED when one of:\n\n1. **CHARTER-touching**: any change that could affect mission, identity NOT-list, autonomous mode rules, or invariants I-S1..I-S35. → Q&A bundle FIRST; decision is the audit of the answered Q&A.\n2. **SCOPE-touching**: phase boundary, multi-track plan, BC count change, port-list scope, dependency-direction reversal.\n3. **ARCH-touching**: library substitution, schema migration, hook architecture, model-routing change.\n4. **IMPL-touching with cross-cutting effect**: decision that affects ≥3 files in different bounded contexts. (Single-file refactors don't need decisions; commit message suffices.)\n5. **Reversal**: any time an earlier decision is paused, revoked, or amended (REV-N or supersedes).\n6. **User-prompt drop**: every `human-workspace/user_prompt/<file>.txt` triggers either a single decision or a Q&A bundle that resolves to one. NEVER silently absorbed.\n\nIf none of the above triggers apply, the action is a **routine implementation choice** — log in session journal, not in decisions/.\n\n---\n\n## How to log a decision\n\n### Step 1 — Author the file\n\nCreate `agent-workspace/memory/decisions/D-NNN-<slug>.md` using the canonical template:\n- `agent-workspace/memory/decisions/_template.md`\n\nFrontmatter is BINDING (12+ fields). Empty arrays trigger drift detection (`DR-PROV` — unanchored claim).\n\n### Step 2 — Cite source_evidence\n\nEvery decision MUST cite at least one upstream source. Acceptable types (in priority order):\n\n1. `human-workspace/user_prompt/<file>.txt` (highest authority)\n2. `human-workspace/decisions/D-H-NNN-*.md` (strategic human decision)\n3. `human-workspace/q-and-a/answered/<file>.md` (resolved Q&A)\n4. `agent-workspace/memory/patterns-discovered/*.md` (mining evidence)\n5. `agent-workspace/memory/post-mortems/*.md` (failure-driven learning)\n6. `agent-workspace/memory/drift-logs/*.md` (drift signal evidence)\n7. `specs/**/*.md` (formal spec clause)\n8. `PROJECT_CHARTER.md § X.Y` (charter section)\n\nA decision with `source_evidence: []` is **invalid** and will be flagged by the drift-detector hook (Track 5).\n\n### Step 3 — Determine level\n\n| Level | Self-decide threshold | Q&A required? |\n|---|---|---|\n| CHARTER | confidence ≥ 0.99 | Almost always YES; charter changes are rare |\n| SCOPE | ≥ 0.90 | Often YES if affects phase or BC structure |\n| ARCH | ≥ 0.80 | Optional; case-by-case |\n| IMPL | ≥ 0.50 | Rarely needed |\n\nConfidence comes from the Confidence Score System (Track 8a) — per-category running estimate. If `sync-tracker.db` does not yet exist (pre-Track 8a), default to \"ask if uncertain.\"\n\n### Step 4 — Approval chain\n\nAppend entries to `approval_chain` as the decision moves PROPOSED → ACCEPTED → AMENDED → SUPERSEDED/REVOKED. Never delete prior entries.\n\n### Step 5 — Cross-link\n\n- Update `agent-workspace/memory/decisions/README.md` index table.\n- If decision affects existing decisions: update their `superseded_by` or `verified_by` arrays.\n- If decision affects code: list paths in `affects.code_paths`.\n\n### Step 6 — Verifier (Tier-2 gate)\n\nFor SCOPE+ decisions, dispatch `sandwich-verifier` subagent for adversarial review BEFORE marking ACCEPTED. The verifier checks:\n- Does `source_evidence` actually contain what was cited?\n- Are `options_considered` exhaustive (or is there a missing option)?\n- Does `chosen_rationale` follow from evidence, or is it inference-only?\n- Are `affects` lists complete (or are there hidden blast-radius surprises)?\n\nVerifier output is appended to `verified_by` field with mechanism `sandwich-verifier`.\n\n---\n\n## When to log a thesis\n\nPer I-S2 + I-S20, every thesis MUST include:\n\n- `source_url` (or local file path) for every fact cited\n- `as_of_date` for every number\n- `confidence` traced to historical hit rate, not LLM \"feeling certain\"\n- `bear_case` section explicit (I-S10)\n\nThesis files live in `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/<ticker>-YYYY-MM-DD.md`. Schema details in `specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md`.\n\n---\n\n## When to log a confidence claim\n\nPer Track 8a (Confidence Score System):\n\n- Every Q&A answered triggers a category update (LANGUAGE, DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS, DESIGN_THINKING, SCOPE, DECISION_ROUTING).\n- Every decision-correction or revocation drops the relevant category by `-2` or `-3` (asymmetric weights, Q&A A5).\n- Hooks (Track 5) auto-update `sync-tracker.db`; agent does NOT manually edit it.\n\nA confidence claim made in narrative (\"I am 80% sure that…\") is INVALID unless it traces to a `sync-tracker.db` entry or `agent-workspace/calibration/<signal>.md` historical data.\n\n---\n\n## R7 Mitigation: Defer-Cycle Tracking\n\nPer Decision 002 REV-2 § C R7 (msmdp Decision Provenance Chain pattern):\n\n- Each defer of a decision increments `defer_cycles` by 1.\n- `defer_cycles > 3` triggers drift-detector alert; mandatory Q&A bundle to either commit or revoke.\n- `re_attempt_prereq` field documents what must change for resumption.\n\nThis is the deterministic backstop against can-kicking. The agent cannot indefinitely postpone a decision while pretending it's \"in progress.\"\n\n---\n\n## Drift Detection Integration (Track 5 hooks)\n\nHook scripts (deferred to Track 5 implementation) will scan:\n\n1. **DR-PROV** — any decision with empty `source_evidence`\n2. **DR-DEFER** — any decision with `defer_cycles > 3`\n3. **DR-CITE** — any thesis or confidence claim missing `source_url` or `as_of_date`\n4. **DR-LLM-MATH** — any narrative output containing computed numbers without code-source citation (I-S1)\n5. **DR-CHARTER** — any decision marked `level: CHARTER` without `human` in `approval_chain`\n6. **DR-ORPHAN** — any `superseded_by: D-NNN` pointing to a non-existent file\n7. **DR-DEP** — any `depends_on` cycle (A→B→A)\n\nEach violation produces a `drift-logs/<TS>-DR-<code>.md` entry; agent must triage in next SessionStart.\n\n---\n\n## Tier-Aware Prompting (when to ask vs. when to log)\n\n| Trigger | Confidence | Action |\n|---|---|---|\n| User-prompt landed; intent unclear | any | Q&A bundle (intent-classifier dispatched) |\n| User-prompt landed; intent clear; no charter/scope conflict | high | Decision auto-logged citing user_prompt |\n| User-prompt landed; intent clear; charter/scope conflict | any | Q&A bundle FIRST; decision is the audit |\n| Pattern mining surfaced amendment | medium | Decision (REV-N or new) citing pattern |\n| Drift detected | n/a | Drift log + decision (if remedy is structural) |\n| Routine implementation choice | high | Session journal only; no decision |\n| ≥ ARCH-tier and confidence < 0.80 | low | Q&A bundle |\n\n---\n\n## Acceptance Process for This Protocol\n\nThis document is in `agent-workspace/proposals/`. {"parentUuid":"ce0776ab-a7d6-47e1-a60e-986e5683f4ba","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_01HjdCp5isD4wz27w2M5duCT","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Q8pRzbbWYhiNGU1gnF2NZi","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\agent-workspace\\memory\\sync-tracker\\README.md","content":"# sync-tracker — Confidence Score System (Track 8a deliverable)\n\n> **Status**: Track 8a IMPL shipped S17 (2026-04-29). See D-006.\n> **Storage substrate**: bash + TSV flat-file MVP per IMPL-S17-1; SQLite migration deferred to Phase 1+ (see D-006 § Open Questions).\n\n## Files\n\n| File | Purpose | Updated by |\n|---|---|---|\n| `events.tsv` | Append-only event log (TSV; header row + per-event rows) | `scripts/hooks/sync-tracker-update.sh` |\n| `state.tsv` | Computed per-category state (5 rows; one per category) | `scripts/hooks/sync-tracker-update.sh` |\n| `weights.yaml` | Tunable weights + thresholds + tier mapping (flat key:value) | manual edit (humans tune) |\n| `_index.md` | Auto-rendered human-readable view | `scripts/hooks/sync-tracker-render.sh` |\n| `README.md` | This file | manual |\n\n## Categories (5)\n\nLANGUAGE / DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS / DESIGN_THINKING / SCOPE / DECISION_ROUTING\n\nInitial score: 50 (mid-range; neither earned confidence nor accumulated correction debt).\n\n## Tier display\n\n```\nscore >= 90  →  HIGH-CONFIDENCE  (🟢 ≥0.90 hit-rate; self-decide IMPL/ARCH freely)\nscore 70-89  →  MED-HIGH         (🟢 0.70-0.89; self-decide IMPL; grill SCOPE+)\nscore 50-69  →  MED              (🟡 0.50-0.69; grill ARCH+; self-decide IMPL with citation)\nscore 30-49  →  MED-LOW          (🟠 0.30-0.49; grill SCOPE+ mandatory; IMPL with double-check)\nscore 0-29   →  MUST-GRILL       (🔴 <0.30; grill ALL decisions until score recovers)\n```\n\n## Thresholds (per-decision-class)\n\n| Class | Threshold | Below-threshold action |\n|---|---|---|\n| CHARTER | 99 | MUST grill via AskUserQuestion (charter-tier letter pick) |\n| SCOPE | 90 | MUST grill via AskUserQuestion |\n| ARCH | 80 | SHOULD grill; if self-decide, double-cite source_evidence |\n| IMPL | 50 | OK to self-decide; subject to drift audit |\n\n## How to use\n\n**Before a decision**: invoke `sync-pull` skill (or read `_index.md` directly). Check the relevant category's score vs threshold. Above → self-decide; below → grill.\n\n**On a Q&A resolution**: hook auto-fires `sync-tracker-update.sh` with delta = +0.1 (q_and_a_resolution).\n\n**On a correction or revocation**: agent emits event to `sync-tracker-update.sh` with negative delta + sets `must_grill_remaining=5` for the affected category.\n\n**On Stop hook**: `sync-tracker-update.sh` re-renders `_index.md`.\n\n## Schema (events.tsv columns; tab-separated)\n\n```\nts                category   event_type                  delta   decision_id  source_evidence    reason\n2026-04-29T...    SCOPE      decision_correctness        +0.5    D-006        D-006-§-Decision   smoke\n```\n\n(See D-006 § Decision for canonical event_type definitions.)\n\n## Migration to SQLite (Phase 1+)\n\nWhen Track 8b ships python + sqlite3 module (S18+), TSV → SQL INSERT is mechanical. Schema:\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE events (\n  event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  ts TEXT NOT NULL,\n  category TEXT NOT NULL,\n  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  delta REAL NOT NULL,\n  decision_id TEXT,\n  source_evidence TEXT,\n  reason TEXT\n);\nCREATE TABLE state (\n  category TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  current_score REAL NOT NULL,\n  sample_count INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  last_updated_ts TEXT NOT NULL,\n  must_grill_remaining INTEGER NOT NULL\n);\n```\n\nMigration: `awk -F'\\t' 'NR>1 {printf \"INSERT INTO events ...\"}' events.tsv | sqlite3 sync-tracker.db`.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":8277,"cache_read_input_tokens":117772,"output_tokens":3280,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":8277,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":3280,"cache_read_input_tokens":117772,"cache_creation_input_tokens":8277,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":8277},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CaYMRtQ3DnpNL8Q4C1Rxu","type":"assistant","uuid":"de403bc8-a358-411e-b39f-04e231832a3c","timestamp":"2026-04-29T16:09:24.657Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"19d00132-2b36-43ad-a05d-5086b0b9d16c","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"ab52287f-3d1e-421d-97f9-d90793eba5fa","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_01G9qzSjwhFYXU63Vr7o6q1E","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01QFi4iULDjKLCv9HN7WDQ8p","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\scripts\\hooks\\sync-tracker-render.sh","content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# sync-tracker-render.sh — Track 8a Confidence Score System render hook\n# Per D-006 (IMPL-S17-1): bash+awk only; no python/jq/yq/sqlite3 (L-S11-1 portability).\n#\n# Reads state.tsv + events.tsv + weights.yaml; generates _index.md (human-readable view).\n# Idempotent — safe to re-run; output is deterministic given inputs.\n\nset -euo pipefail\n\nROOT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")/../..\" && pwd)\"\nSYNC_DIR=\"$ROOT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker\"\nEVENTS=\"$SYNC_DIR/events.tsv\"\nSTATE=\"$SYNC_DIR/state.tsv\"\nWEIGHTS=\"$SYNC_DIR/weights.yaml\"\nINDEX=\"$SYNC_DIR/_index.md\"\n\nget_weight() { awk -F': *' -v key=\"$1\" '$1==key {print $2; exit}' \"$WEIGHTS\"; }\n\nT_CHARTER=\"$(get_weight threshold_CHARTER)\"\nT_SCOPE=\"$(get_weight threshold_SCOPE)\"\nT_ARCH=\"$(get_weight threshold_ARCH)\"\nT_IMPL=\"$(get_weight threshold_IMPL)\"\n\nT_HIGH=\"$(get_weight tier_HIGH)\"\nT_MED_HIGH=\"$(get_weight tier_MED_HIGH)\"\nT_MED=\"$(get_weight tier_MED)\"\nT_MED_LOW=\"$(get_weight tier_MED_LOW)\"\n\n# Render\nRENDER_TS=\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\"\n{\n  cat <<MD\n# Confidence Score Index — sync-tracker\n\n> **Auto-generated** by \\`scripts/hooks/sync-tracker-render.sh\\`. Do NOT edit by hand.\n> **Last rendered**: $RENDER_TS\n> **Source**: D-006 (Track 8a) + Charter Principle 8 (Calibration over confidence)\n> **Storage**: bash+TSV flat-file MVP per IMPL-S17-1; SQLite migration deferred Phase 1+\n\n## Current State (5 categories)\n\n| Category | Score | Tier | Sample Count | Last Updated | Must-Grill Remaining |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\nMD\n\n  # Render category rows with tier mapping inline\n  awk -F'\\t' -v th=\"$T_HIGH\" -v tmh=\"$T_MED_HIGH\" -v tm=\"$T_MED\" -v tml=\"$T_MED_LOW\" '\nNR==1 { next }\n{\n  score = $2 + 0;\n  if (score >= th)        tier = \"🟢 HIGH-CONFIDENCE  (≥0.90 hit-rate)\";\n  else if (score >= tmh)  tier = \"🟢 MED-HIGH         (0.70-0.89)\";\n  else if (score >= tm)   tier = \"🟡 MED              (0.50-0.69)\";\n  else if (score >= tml)  tier = \"🟠 MED-LOW          (0.30-0.49)\";\n  else                    tier = \"🔴 MUST-GRILL       (<0.30)\";\n  printf \"| %s | %g | %s | %d | %s | %d |\\n\", $1, score, tier, $3, $4, $5;\n}\n' \"$STATE\"\n\n  cat <<MD\n\n## Decision-Class Thresholds\n\n| Decision class | Threshold | Action when current_score < threshold |\n|---|---|---|\n| CHARTER | $T_CHARTER | MUST grill via AskUserQuestion (charter-tier letter pick) |\n| SCOPE | $T_SCOPE | MUST grill via AskUserQuestion |\n| ARCH | $T_ARCH | SHOULD grill; if self-decide, double-cite source_evidence |\n| IMPL | $T_IMPL | OK to self-decide; subject to drift audit |\n\n> Threshold check: \\`current_score >= threshold\\` → safe to self-decide. Below → grill.\n\n## Recent Events (top 10 newest)\n\n| ts | category | event_type | delta | decision_id | reason |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\nMD\n\n  # Render top-10 events from events.tsv (most recent first)\n  awk -F'\\t' '\nNR==1 { next }\n{\n  printf \"| %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s |\\n\", $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $7;\n}\n' \"$EVENTS\" | tail -n 10\n\n  cat <<MD\n\n## How to use\n\n- **Before SCOPE+ decision**: invoke \\`sync-pull\\` skill OR check this file's category row.\n- **If category score below decision-class threshold**: MUST grill (AskUserQuestion).\n- **If \\`Must-Grill Remaining\\` > 0**: forced grill regardless of score (reversal protocol per Q&A A6).\n- **Weights tunable**: edit \\`weights.yaml\\`; re-run \\`sync-tracker-update.sh\\` with any event to recompute.\n\n## Source schema\n\n- Categories (5): LANGUAGE / DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS / DESIGN_THINKING / SCOPE / DECISION_ROUTING\n- Tier boundaries: see \\`weights.yaml\\` (\\`tier_*\\` keys)\n- Asymmetric weights: see \\`weights.yaml\\` (\\`weight_*\\` keys; positive = earned confidence; negative = correction debt)\n\nSee \\`README.md\\` for full schema; \\`D-006\\` for design rationale.\nMD\n} > \"$INDEX.tmp\" && mv \"$INDEX.tmp\" \"$INDEX\"\n\nexit 0\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":474,"cache_read_input_tokens":134045,"output_tokens":2442,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":474,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":2442,"cache_read_input_tokens":134045,"cache_creation_input_tokens":474,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":474},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CaYMYYVR6fZ6H2VMzC1SM","type":"assistant","uuid":"8909143a-ed9c-4867-a3df-e61aadbce478","timestamp":"2026-04-29T16:10:45.607Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"19d00132-2b36-43ad-a05d-5086b0b9d16c","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

Below → grill.\n\n## Recent Events (top 10 newest)\n\n| ts | category | event_type | delta | decision_id | reason |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\nMD\n\n  # Render top-10 events from events.tsv (most recent first)\n  awk -F'\\t' '\nNR==1 { next }\n{\n  printf \"| %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s |\\n\", $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $7;\n}\n' \"$EVENTS\" | tail -n 10\n\n  cat <<MD\n\n## How to use\n\n- **Before SCOPE+ decision**: invoke \\`sync-pull\\` skill OR check this file's category row.\n- **If category score below decision-class threshold**: MUST grill (AskUserQuestion).\n- **If \\`Must-Grill Remaining\\` > 0**: forced grill regardless of score (reversal protocol per Q&A A6).\n- **Weights tunable**: edit \\`weights.yaml\\`; re-run \\`sync-tracker-update.sh\\` with any event to recompute.\n\n## Source schema\n\n- Categories (5): LANGUAGE / DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS / DESIGN_THINKING / SCOPE / DECISION_ROUTING\n- Tier boundaries: see \\`weights.yaml\\` (\\`tier_*\\` keys)\n- Asymmetric weights: see \\`weights.yaml\\` (\\`weight_*\\` keys; positive = earned confidence; negative = correction debt)\n\nSee \\`README.md\\` for full schema; \\`D-006\\` for design rationale.\nMD\n} > \"$INDEX.tmp\" && mv \"$INDEX.tmp\" \"$INDEX\"\n\nexit 0\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"8909143a-ed9c-4867-a3df-e61aadbce478","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"19d00132-2b36-43ad-a05d-5086b0b9d16c","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"3f649c38-ab9d-44d9-99a5-31b3e2acab01","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_01E1xyPaxprFGWtxzFBLgmaa","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01WttaPPxXpMqiys2rc9g2QC","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\.claude\\skills\\sync-pull\\SKILL.md","content":"---\nname: sync-pull\ndescription: On-demand confidence-score lookup before a SCOPE+/ARCH/IMPL decision. Reads agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker/state.tsv + weights.yaml; surfaces the relevant category's score, tier, must-grill flag, and the decision-class threshold. Output drives \"self-decide vs grill\" choice. Use whenever an agent is about to commit a non-trivial decision and needs to ground confidence in historical hit rate per Charter Principle 8 (Calibration over confidence).\nallowed-tools: [Read, Glob, Grep, Bash]\n---\n\n# Skill: sync-pull\n\n## Purpose\n\nPer Charter Principle 8 (Calibration over confidence) + D-006 (Track 8a Confidence Score System): every confidence claim must trace to historical hit rate, not to model \"feeling certain\". Before committing a SCOPE+/ARCH/IMPL decision, the agent invokes this skill to read the current per-category score from `agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker/state.tsv` and decide whether to self-decide (above threshold) or grill (below threshold).\n\nThis skill is the runtime consumer side of Track 8a; the producer side is `scripts/hooks/sync-tracker-update.sh` which appends events as they happen.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- Pre-flight before authoring a decision file in `agent-workspace/memory/decisions/` (especially level: SCOPE / ARCH).\n- Agent is about to choose between AskUserQuestion bundle and self-decide — score check disambiguates.\n- Drift detector flags a category; sync-pull reads `must_grill_remaining` to confirm forced-grill state.\n- Mid-session \"should I keep going or open Q&A bundle?\" — sync-pull anchors the call.\n\n## When NOT to Use\n\n- Routine IMPL-tier choice already in flight (overhead cost > value).\n- Session is in PLAN mode and decisions are Q&A-driven by spec — sync-pull adds no signal.\n- `_index.md` was just rendered same session — read it directly instead of re-invoking.\n\n## Inputs\n\n| Arg | Required | Purpose |\n|---|---|---|\n| `category` | yes | One of: LANGUAGE / DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS / DESIGN_THINKING / SCOPE / DECISION_ROUTING |\n| `decision_class` | no | One of: CHARTER / SCOPE / ARCH / IMPL. If provided, skill compares score vs that class's threshold and emits explicit \"self-decide\" or \"grill\" recommendation. |\n\n## Process\n\n1. **Read state row** — `awk -F'\\t' '$1==\"<CATEGORY>\"' agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker/state.tsv` returns the row with current_score / sample_count / last_updated_ts / must_grill_remaining.\n2. **Read threshold** — if `decision_class` provided, `awk -F': *' '$1==\"threshold_<CLASS>\"' agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker/weights.yaml` returns the threshold value.\n3. **Apply tier mapping** — score → tier name via `weights.yaml` `tier_*` boundaries (HIGH ≥90 / MED_HIGH ≥70 / MED ≥50 / MED_LOW ≥30 / MUST_GRILL <30).\n4. **Apply decision rule**:\n   - If `must_grill_remaining > 0`: emit FORCE-GRILL (reversal protocol active per Q&A A6).\n   - Else if `decision_class` given AND `current_score < threshold`: emit GRILL.\n   - Else: emit SELF-DECIDE-OK with citation note.\n5. **Output** — structured single-paragraph readout the agent can paste into its reasoning log.\n\n## Output format\n\n```\nsync-pull <CATEGORY> [<DECISION_CLASS>]:\n  current_score=<N>/100  (tier: <TIER_NAME>)\n  sample_count=<K>  last_updated=<TS>\n  must_grill_remaining=<M>\n  threshold_<CLASS>=<T>  (for decision_class=<CLASS>)\n  recommendation: <SELF-DECIDE-OK | GRILL | FORCE-GRILL>\n  reasoning: <one sentence>\n```\n\n## Examples\n\n**Example 1 — Pre-flight before SCOPE-tier decision (above threshold)**:\n```\nsync-pull SCOPE SCOPE\n  current_score=92/100  (tier: HIGH-CONFIDENCE)\n  sample_count=14  last_updated=2026-04-29T10:33:00Z\n  must_grill_remaining=0\n  threshold_SCOPE=90\n  recommendation: SELF-DECIDE-OK\n  reasoning: score 92 ≥ threshold 90; no must-grill flag; safe to self-decide with citation.\n```\n\n**Example 2 — Below threshold (grill required)**:\n```\nsync-pull DECISION_ROUTING ARCH\n  current_score=72/100  (tier: MED-HIGH)\n  sample_count=22  last_updated=2026-04-29T11:00:00Z\n  must_grill_remaining=0\n  threshold_ARCH=80\n  recommendation: GRILL\n  reasoning: score 72 < threshold 80; route via AskUserQuestion bundle.\n```\n\n**Example 3 — Reversal protocol active (force grill)**:\n```\nsync-pull DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS IMPL\n  current_score=48/100  (tier: MED-LOW)\n  sample_count=8  last_updated=2026-04-29T12:15:00Z\n  must_grill_remaining=4\n  threshold_IMPL=50\n  recommendation: FORCE-GRILL\n  reasoning: must_grill_remaining=4 (reversal protocol active); grill regardless of score until counter reaches 0.\n```\n\n## Outputs\n\nThe skill writes nothing — it's a read-only lookup. Producer (`scripts/hooks/sync-tracker-update.sh`) is the writer.\n\nIf the agent acts on a SELF-DECIDE-OK and later proves wrong, the producer hook fires `decision_correction_-2` event; sync-pull on next invocation will reflect the dropped score.\n\n## Source schema\n\n- D-006 § Decision (canonical schema; bash+TSV substrate per IMPL-S17-1)\n- `agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker/README.md` (layer overview)\n- `agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker/weights.yaml` (tunable thresholds + tier boundaries)\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Citing \"I'm 80% confident\" without sync-pull** — Charter Principle 8 violation. Confidence claims must trace to state.tsv or `agent-workspace/calibration/<signal>.md` historical data.\n- **Skipping sync-pull on SCOPE/ARCH** — invalidates the calibration loop; correction events will fire later but score won't have grounded the decision in advance.\n- **Editing state.tsv by hand** — bypasses the producer hook's event-log discipline. Always emit events via `sync-tracker-update.sh` so the audit trail survives.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2023,"cache_read_input_tokens":137083,"output_tokens":2840,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2023,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":2840,"cache_read_input_tokens":137083,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2023,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2023},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CaYMbU18ED8khCwzwdBG7","type":"assistant","uuid":"a08c4de9-1641-4493-8d7a-c2891b4f8951","timestamp":"2026-04-29T16:11:32.125Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"19d00132-2b36-43ad-a05d-5086b0b9d16c","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

Call sync-tracker-render.sh to regenerate _index.md (best-effort; log if fails).","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# sync-tracker-update.sh — Track 8a Confidence Score System update hook\n# Per D-006 (IMPL-S17-1): bash+awk only; no python/jq/yq/sqlite3 (L-S11-1 portability).\n#\n# Usage:\n#   sync-tracker-update.sh <category> <event_type> <delta> [<decision_id> [<source_evidence> [<reason>]]]\n#\n# Categories: LANGUAGE | DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS | DESIGN_THINKING | SCOPE | DECISION_ROUTING\n# Event types: decision_correctness | charter_match | q_and_a_resolution\n#              drift_signal | decision_correction | decision_revocation | thesis_revocation\n#\n# Behavior:\n#   1. Append event row to events.tsv (atomic append).\n#   2. Recompute state.tsv from full events.tsv replay.\n#   3. Decrement must_grill_remaining for the affected category if >0.\n#   4. Call sync-tracker-render.sh to regenerate _index.md (best-effort; log if fails).\n\nset -euo pipefail\n\nROOT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")/../..\" && pwd)\"\nSYNC_DIR=\"$ROOT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker\"\nEVENTS=\"$SYNC_DIR/events.tsv\"\nSTATE=\"$SYNC_DIR/state.tsv\"\nWEIGHTS=\"$SYNC_DIR/weights.yaml\"\nRENDER_HOOK=\"$ROOT_DIR/scripts/hooks/sync-tracker-render.sh\"\nLOG=\"$ROOT_DIR/.session-hooks.log\"\n\nCAT=\"${1:-}\"\nEVT=\"${2:-}\"\nDELTA=\"${3:-}\"\nDEC_ID=\"${4:-}\"\nSOURCE_EV=\"${5:-}\"\nREASON=\"${6:-}\"\n\nif [[ -z \"$CAT\" || -z \"$EVT\" || -z \"$DELTA\" ]]; then\n  echo \"[sync-tracker-update] usage: $0 <category> <event_type> <delta> [<decision_id> [<source_evidence> [<reason>]]]\" >&2\n  exit 2\nfi\n\n# Validate category\ncase \"$CAT\" in\n  LANGUAGE|DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS|DESIGN_THINKING|SCOPE|DECISION_ROUTING) ;;\n  *) echo \"[sync-tracker-update] invalid category: $CAT\" >&2; exit 2 ;;\nesac\n\nTS=\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\"\n\n# Append event (TSV; tab-separated; replace tabs in fields with spaces to keep single line)\nsanitize() { printf '%s' \"${1:-}\" | tr '\\t\\n' '  '; }\nprintf '%s\\t%s\\t%s\\t%s\\t%s\\t%s\\t%s\\n' \\\n  \"$TS\" \"$CAT\" \"$EVT\" \"$DELTA\" \\\n  \"$(sanitize \"$DEC_ID\")\" \"$(sanitize \"$SOURCE_EV\")\" \"$(sanitize \"$REASON\")\" \\\n  >> \"$EVENTS\"\n\n# --- Recompute state.tsv ---\n# Read initial scores from weights.yaml (category_<NAME>: <int>)\nget_weight() { awk -F': *' -v key=\"$1\" '$1==key {print $2; exit}' \"$WEIGHTS\"; }\n\nINIT_LANG=\"$(get_weight category_LANGUAGE)\"\nINIT_DOM=\"$(get_weight category_DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS)\"\nINIT_DES=\"$(get_weight category_DESIGN_THINKING)\"\nINIT_SCO=\"$(get_weight category_SCOPE)\"\nINIT_DEC=\"$(get_weight category_DECISION_ROUTING)\"\n\n# Preserve must_grill_remaining from existing state.tsv (so decrement persists across runs)\nget_grill() { awk -F'\\t' -v cat=\"$1\" 'NR>1 && $1==cat {print $5; exit}' \"$STATE\"; }\nGRILL_LANG=\"$(get_grill LANGUAGE)\"; GRILL_LANG=\"${GRILL_LANG:-0}\"\nGRILL_DOM=\"$(get_grill DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS)\"; GRILL_DOM=\"${GRILL_DOM:-0}\"\nGRILL_DES=\"$(get_grill DESIGN_THINKING)\"; GRILL_DES=\"${GRILL_DES:-0}\"\nGRILL_SCO=\"$(get_grill SCOPE)\"; GRILL_SCO=\"${GRILL_SCO:-0}\"\nGRILL_DEC=\"$(get_grill DECISION_ROUTING)\"; GRILL_DEC=\"${GRILL_DEC:-0}\"\n\n# Reversal protocol: revocation events set must_grill_remaining=5\nRVC=\"$(get_weight reversal_must_grill_cycles)\"; RVC=\"${RVC:-5}\"\ncase \"$EVT\" in\n  decision_revocation|thesis_revocation)\n    case \"$CAT\" in\n      LANGUAGE) GRILL_LANG=\"$RVC\" ;;\n      DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS) GRILL_DOM=\"$RVC\" ;;\n      DESIGN_THINKING) GRILL_DES=\"$RVC\" ;;\n      SCOPE) GRILL_SCO=\"$RVC\" ;;\n      DECISION_ROUTING) GRILL_DEC=\"$RVC\" ;;\n    esac\n    ;;\nesac\n\n# Replay events.tsv to compute current scores + sample counts + last_updated_ts.\nawk -F'\\t' -v il=\"$INIT_LANG\" -v id=\"$INIT_DOM\" -v ie=\"$INIT_DES\" -v is=\"$INIT_SCO\" -v ir=\"$INIT_DEC\" \\\n    -v gl=\"$GRILL_LANG\" -v gd=\"$GRILL_DOM\" -v ge=\"$GRILL_DES\" -v gs=\"$GRILL_SCO\" -v gr=\"$GRILL_DEC\" '\nBEGIN {\n  s[\"LANGUAGE\"]=il; s[\"DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS\"]=id; s[\"DESIGN_THINKING\"]=ie; s[\"SCOPE\"]=is; s[\"DECISION_ROUTING\"]=ir;\n  c[\"LANGUAGE\"]=0; c[\"DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS\"]=0; c[\"DESIGN_THINKING\"]=0; c[\"SCOPE\"]=0; c[\"DECISION_ROUTING\"]=0;\n  t[\"LANGUAGE\"]=\"1970-01-01T00:00:00Z\"; t[\"DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS\"]=\"1970-01-01T00:00:00Z\";\n  t[\"DESIGN_THINKING\"]=\"1970-01-01T00:00:00Z\"; t[\"SCOPE\"]=\"1970-01-01T00:00:00Z\";\n  t[\"DECISION_ROUTING\"]=\"1970-01-01T00:00:00Z\";\n  g[\"LANGUAGE\"]=gl; g[\"DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS\"]=gd; g[\"DESIGN_THINKING\"]=ge; g[\"SCOPE\"]=gs; g[\"DECISION_ROUTING\"]=gr;\n  cats=\"LANGUAGE DOMAIN_UBIQUITOUS DESIGN_THINKING SCOPE DECISION_ROUTING\";\n}\nNR==1 { next }  # skip header\n$2 in s {\n  s[$2] += $4 + 0;\n  if (s[$2] < 0) s[$2] = 0;\n  if (s[$2] > 100) s[$2] = 100;\n  c[$2] += 1;\n  if ($1 > t[$2]) t[$2] = $1;\n}\nEND {\n  print \"category\\tcurrent_score\\tsample_count\\tlast_updated_ts\\tmust_grill_remaining\";\n  n=split(cats, arr, \" \");\n  for (i=1; i<=n; i++) {\n    k=arr[i];\n    printf \"%s\\t%g\\t%d\\t%s\\t%d\\n\", k, s[k], c[k], t[k], g[k];\n  }\n}\n' \"$EVENTS\" > \"$STATE.tmp\" && mv \"$STATE.tmp\" \"$STATE\"\n\n# Decrement must_grill_remaining for the just-affected category (if it was >0 before this event)\n# (Decrement happens AFTER state replay so the recorded grill count reflects post-event state.)\ncase \"$EVT\" in\n  decision_revocation|thesis_revocation) ;;  # already set fresh above\n  *)\n    awk -F'\\t' -v cat=\"$CAT\" -v OFS='\\t' '\nNR==1 { print; next }\n$1==cat && $5+0 > 0 { $5 = $5 - 1; print; next }\n{ print }\n' \"$STATE\" > \"$STATE.tmp\" && mv \"$STATE.tmp\" \"$STATE\"\n    ;;\nesac\n\n# Render _index.md (best-effort)\nif [[ -x \"$RENDER_HOOK\" ]];
